ranked_candidates.headline: OpenAI Officially Launches ChatGPT Search: The Direct Challenge to Google's 25-Year Search Monopoly
ranked_candidates.verdict: Highest scoring global story. Directly impacts over 250 million active users worldwide, fundamentally shifts the web search paradigm from 10 blue links to conversational multimodal synthesis, backed by primary engineering documentation and live developer access.

ranked_candidates.headline: Physical Intelligence Unveils pi-0: Continuous Flow Matching Action Model for 50 Hz Robotics
ranked_candidates.rejection_reason: Exceptional technical paper and robotics milestone, but already thoroughly covered in yesterday's pre-production cycle (RES-PI0-2026-001). Selecting it today would violate the core requirement: 'Do not restrict research to one company, country, technology, or previously used topic.'

ranked_candidates.headline: Hugging Face Releases SmolLM2: 135M, 360M, and 1.7B Parameter Models for Local On-Device AI
ranked_candidates.rejection_reason: Strong open-source milestone proving high dataset filtering efficiency on edge devices, but lower mainstream impact compared to the global disruption of internet search.

ranked_candidates.headline: Anthropic Claude 3.5 Sonnet Computer Use API Expansion
ranked_candidates.rejection_reason: Failed 24-hour freshness gate. The primary engineering launch was October 22, 2024. Current articles are secondary commentary and implementation writeups, not breaking news.

ranked_candidates.headline: Google DeepMind Scales Gemini 1.5 Flash-8B Production Deployments
ranked_candidates.rejection_reason: Incremental steady-state cloud rollout. Insufficient narrative tension and novelty for a standalone investigative documentary.
